_comment: Personal config for the event-radar skill. Copy to event-radar.config.json (which is gitignored) and edit — OR let the skill auto-fill it interactively on first run via AskUserQuestion. The skill reads this on every run; the skill writes back to it (distance_cache_km, venues.known_about, ticket_history, research_caveats) as it learns.

venues._comment: preferred = boost weight; avoid = exclude; known_about = auto-discovered cache populated by the skill.

distance_cache_km._comment: Self-populated by the skill. Keys are 'City, Country'. Values rounded km from home_city. Skill checks here before computing.

ticket_history._comment: Format: {date, event, venue, status: 'bought'|'attended'|'wishlist'}. The skill flags events here with ✅ in output instead of re-recommending them.

research_caveats._comment: Self-learned during runs. Skill appends here when it discovers fake-news / cancelled events / skip-NL artists worth remembering across runs.
research_caveats._corrected_comment: Entries proven wrong on a later verify run. Do NOT re-add these to skip_nl_artists. A skip-NL entry has a shelf life of roughly one quarter — re-verify any entry older than ~3 months.

event_series_calendar_hints._comment: Recurring annual event series the user has interest in, with typical timing. Skill checks the latest official lineup each year. User-curated (not auto-populated).
